item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
A super minor thing, but…

"Contact with the arch is necessary for this phenomenon, as birds flying above it in the same direction experience no effects."
vs
"…a ground squirrel being chased by the family dog across the arch, with both vanishing in mid-leap at the center."

Seems kind of contradictory, with the way it's worded.

Otherwise I like the SCP a lot. It makes me really wonder what's going on from when the organism disappears to when its non-organic parts reappear. It's got me so intrigued that I've been trying to think of a way to "beat" it and record what happens "inside" (haha and I'm failing pretty badly so far)

I like the simple disappearing thing it's got going now tbh. I'm constantly seeing people being told that not everything has to be "OH MY GOD IT'S [DATA EXPUNGED] SIDEWAYS WITH HIS [REDACTED]", and something this weird, which we don't know much about makes a good change.

I mean, it still has to be contained, otherwise people would notice that others were vanishing.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
As I'm thinking about it, I wonder if I actually got across my intent in the article before. The "turning people into stars" bit was what the locals believed and passed on in their folklore. With the little postscript I was trying to get across that they might very well have been wrong, and that what was really happening might be that some malevolent entities (the stars?) had tricked them into believing it and were growing stronger and better fed every time someone crossed the bridge.

It might also be that I'm trying to defend my original concept because I'm drawing a blank for major revisions ;).

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Making it so only humans get turned into stars solves a small logistical problem, but would make it even cheesier.

You decided to call this bridge "Dream Bridge". I guess it's mostly because that's what it's known as, but maybe make it so it actually does something with dreams? Maybe this is responsible for SCP-990? Maybe SCP-781 could go home this way?

Just an idea. It's so well written that I'd like to see you try and come up with something better than "THEY TURN INTO STARS"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Would it be any better if I changed it so that new stars only appear when humans cross the arch? I understand thinking that the star bit is cliched, but it was the best idea I could come up with and I certainly wanted there to be some effect on the world at large when people vanish on the bridge. As for the addendum being cheesy … I've always been bad at horror and that, for better or worse, represents the best I've got.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The whole thing with new stars appearing doesn't sit well with me. It's just a little cliche and ridiculous at the same time. I mean, think about all the living matter that must unintentionally cross that bridge; insects, ect … that completely aside, it's weird to me that we could run a crate-full of squirrels across this thing and completely change the sky. Also it seems like a weird thing to notice.

The addendum is also cheesy I think … y'know, it occurs to me that the addendum would sound less cheesy if you left it, but took out the stars thing xD

I dunno, I thought you were going somewhere good with this and when I got to the stars bit I was a bit disappointed. I mean, if you take away the stars thing you'd have to add something else, because "bridge what makes you disappear" is ultimately a bland concept (even though it's very well written!).
